subject.title: Gateway memory leak: 389MB → 14.7GB over 4 days with session accumulation

question: What representative profiling and soak evidence is sufficient to split or close the broad Gateway RSS/session-accumulation tracker?
rationale: Automation can identify partial source contributors, but only maintainers can choose the accepted workload shape and proof bar for declaring the multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM family resolved.

options.title: Keep Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker until narrow fixes land and a maintainer-accepted multi-day soak/profile shows RSS plateauing.

options.title: Split Remaining Roots
options.body: Create or promote narrower issues for session-store bloat, diagnostic hot paths, spawnedByCache, plugin/native memory, and embedding failure paths, while linking them back here.

options.title: Close After Partial Fixes
options.body: Close after the current narrow PRs land without requiring a broad soak, accepting that new field reports may need fresh issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker until narrow fixes land and a maintainer-accepted multi-day soak/profile shows RSS plateauing.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned and already stated the representative soak/profiling closure bar in the issue discussion.
